name: Spotlight Parrotfish
summary: A small marine fish recorded in Leonida, with a reported range along Leonida’s southern coastline.
description: This fish is described as common in southern coastal waters, with no special bait or lure required. It is also connected to an early fishing side mission; exact mission details remain to be confirmed in-game.
